svg.title: BlaBla agent workflow
svg.desc: An agent starts from the AGENTS.md block, runs blabla status, sees which layer and which rules need attention, runs blabla explain on one rule, edits the implementation, and runs blabla finish. RED or YELLOW leads back to editing; OVERALL GREEN is the only completion signal.
